names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind the company’s line for 3 апреля ст. ст., name page 463, «Галик, мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The calendar gives him no surname and no toponymic, so the bare forename is the fullest form it has, and no folder holds it.
